steps.title: Group reciprocal terms
steps.bodyLatex: Divide the equation by $Z^2$: $Z^2 + 1/Z^2 - (Z + 1/Z) + 2 = 0$. Let $w = Z + 1/Z$, then $Z^2 + 1/Z^2 = w^2 - 2$.
